units.source_text: 这回小君敲边门，一个小侍女来开了，他就进去。

en.t: This time Kokimi knocked at the side gate, and when a young maid came to open it, he went inside.
He saw that all the maids had fallen quietly asleep.

units.source_text: 他说：“我睡在这纸隔扇口吧，这里通风，凉快些。”

en.t: He said, "I will sleep here by the paper partition; the air comes through here, so it is a little cooler."

units.source_text: 他就把席子摊开，躺下了。

en.t: Then he spread out his mat and lay down.

units.source_text: 众侍女都睡在东面的厢房里。

en.t: All the maids were sleeping in the eastern side room.

units.source_text: 刚才替他开门的那小侍女也进去睡了。

en.t: The young maid who had opened the gate for him earlier had also gone in to sleep.

units.source_text: 小君假装睡着，过了一会儿，他拿屏风遮住了灯光，悄悄地引导公子到了这暗影的地方。

en.t: Kokimi pretended to be asleep, and after a while he used a screen to block the lamplight and quietly led the young lord to that shadowed place.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“不知究竟如何？

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "I wonder how this will turn out?
I hope I am not rejected again!"
In his heart he was very timid and afraid.

units.source_text: 终于由小君引导，撩起了帷屏上的垂布，钻进正房里去了。

en.t: At last, guided by Kokimi, he lifted the hanging cloth from the curtain screen and slipped into the main room.

units.source_text: 这时候更深人静，可以分明地听到他的衣服的窸窣声。

en.t: By then the night was deep and everyone was silent, so the rustle of his robes could be heard clearly.
